description: This Java source file defines the UserCreatedShelfService class, which manages user-created book shelves in a book tracking application. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, saving, deleting, and checking existence of custom shelves, as well as fetching books within a specific shelf.

classes.name: UserCreatedShelfService
classes.description: Service class managing user-created shelves, providing CRUD operations and utility methods for shelves and their books.

methods.name: createCustomShelf
methods.description: Creates a new UserCreatedShelf instance with the specified name for the current user.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a UserCreatedShelf by its ID.

methods.name: findAllForLoggedInUser
methods.description: Retrieves all shelves for the currently logged-in user.

methods.name: findByShelfNameAndLoggedInUser
methods.description: Finds a shelf by name for the current user.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a UserCreatedShelf, throwing exception if the shelf name already exists.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of user-created shelves.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all shelves matching a specific name.

methods.name: getBooksInCustomShelf
methods.description: Returns all books in the specified custom shelf.

methods.name: getCustomShelfByName
methods.description: Retrieves a custom shelf by name, if it exists.

methods.name: findOrCreate
methods.description: Finds a shelf by name or creates it if it does not exist.

methods.name: shelfNameExists
methods.description: Checks if a shelf name exists, considering predefined shelves.
